mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate directly reduces the risk-free rate used in equity valuation models, leading to higher present values of future cash flows and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as recession risks increase.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad consumer demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as consumption weakness pressures earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline >1.0% monthly, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent industrial production growth below 0.5% annually indicates supply chain disruption, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to inflationary pressures and reduced corporate margins.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO annual growth < 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 > 2.0% annualized) reflects robust economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth > 2.0% annualized, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% signals persistent price pressures, prompting restrictive monetary policy and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as rate hikes become imminent.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent unemployment rate increases and payroll growth declines indicate labor market weakening, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as economic slowdown intensifies.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises >0.3pp and PAYEMS growth declines >0.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) immediately increase discount rates and reduce risk appetite, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.
